items.name: MetricBuilder
items.summary: Structure for constructing metrics, counters, timers, etc.

methods.name: build
methods.summary: Consume self and create a metric of the specified value registered with the MetricsSet

methods.name: counter
methods.signature: fn counter(self, counter_name: impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>, partition: usize) -> Count
methods.summary: Consumes self and creates a new [`Count`] for recording some arbitrary metric of an operator.

methods.name: elapsed_compute
methods.summary: Consume self and create a new Timer for recording the elapsed CPU time spent by an operator

methods.name: end_timestamp
methods.summary: Consumes self and creates a new Timestamp for recording the ending time of execution for a partition

methods.name: gauge
methods.signature: fn gauge(self, gauge_name: impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>, partition: usize) -> Gauge
methods.summary: Consumes self and creates a new [`Gauge`] for reporting some arbitrary metric of an operator.

methods.name: global_counter
methods.signature: fn global_counter(self, counter_name: impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>) -> Count
methods.summary: Consumes self and creates a new [`Count`] for recording a metric of an overall operator (not per partition)

methods.name: global_gauge
methods.signature: fn global_gauge(self, gauge_name: impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>) -> Gauge
methods.summary: Consumes self and creates a new [`Gauge`] for reporting a metric of an overall operator (not per partition)

methods.name: mem_used
methods.summary: Consume self and create a new gauge for reporting current memory usage

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new `MetricBuilder` that will register the result of `build()` with the `metrics`

methods.name: output_batches
methods.summary: Consume self and create a new counter for recording total output batches

methods.name: output_bytes
methods.summary: Consume self and create a new counter for recording total output bytes

methods.name: output_rows
methods.summary: Consume self and create a new counter for recording output rows

methods.name: peak_memory_usage
methods.signature: fn peak_memory_usage(self, gauge_name: impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>, partition: usize) -> Gauge
methods.summary: Consumes self and creates a new [`Gauge`] for recording peak memory usage in bytes.

methods.name: pruning_metrics
methods.signature: fn pruning_metrics(self, name: impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>, partition: usize) -> PruningMetrics
methods.summary: Consumes self and creates a new `PruningMetrics`

methods.name: ratio_metrics
methods.signature: fn ratio_metrics(self, name: impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>, partition: usize) -> RatioMetrics
methods.summary: Consumes self and creates a new [`RatioMetrics`]

methods.name: ratio_metrics_with_strategy
methods.signature: fn ratio_metrics_with_strategy(self, name: impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>, partition: usize, merge_strategy: RatioMergeStrategy) -> RatioMetrics
methods.summary: Consumes self and creates a new [`RatioMetrics`] with a specific merge strategy

methods.name: spill_count
methods.summary: Consume self and create a new counter for recording the number of spills triggered by an operator

methods.name: spilled_bytes
methods.summary: Consume self and create a new counter for recording the total spilled bytes triggered by an operator

methods.name: spilled_rows
methods.summary: Consume self and create a new counter for recording the total spilled rows triggered by an operator

methods.name: start_timestamp
methods.summary: Consumes self and creates a new Timestamp for recording the starting time of execution for a partition

methods.name: subset_time
methods.signature: fn subset_time(self, subset_name: impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>, partition: usize) -> Time
methods.summary: Consumes self and creates a new Timer for recording some subset of an operators execution time.

methods.name: with_category
methods.summary: Set the semantic category for the metric being constructed.

methods.name: with_label
methods.summary: Add a label to the metric being constructed

methods.name: with_new_label
methods.signature: fn with_new_label(self, name: impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>, value: impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>) -> Self
methods.summary: Add a label to the metric being constructed

methods.name: with_partition
methods.summary: Set the partition of the metric being constructed

methods.name: with_type
methods.summary: Set the metric type to the metric being constructed
